title: Additive presentation of degree-zero cohomology fractions
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $L,F$ be $\mathcal O_X$-modules, $s\in\Gamma(X,L)$, $U\subseteq X$ open, and $p\in\mathbb N$. Using the tensor powers of [def-sc-invertible-module] and open module cohomology [def-sc-open-module-cohomology], form $D=\bigoplus_{n\geq0} H^p(U,(F\otimes L^{\otimes n})|_U)$. Define the additive fraction presentation $D/R$, where $R$ is the additive subgroup generated by $\iota_n(\xi)-\iota_{n+b}(s^b\xi)$ for all $n,b\geq0$ and $\xi\in H^p(U,(F\otimes L^{\otimes n})|_U)$; multiplication by $s^b$ is induced by tensor multiplication of sheaves. Write $[n,\xi]$ for its class, representing $\xi/s^n$. When $L$ is invertible this is the underlying additive group of the degree-zero homogeneous localization of $H^p_*(U,L,F)$ at $s$ (Stacks 09MR).
